notes: Cross-verse split: מִחְיָה and חַי were assigned each other's English. The chapter renders חַי by *raw* (13.14, 13.15 twice, 13.16) and מִחְיָה by *quick* (13.24, where *flesh* is italicized as a supply); 13.10 had מִחְיָה → *raw* and חַי → *quick*. Swapped t027 and t028 so the two lemmas read as they do everywhere else in the chapter. No other unit in the verse changes.
